QuestInfo.name: Roses for Cassandra
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra looks busy. Go see what she's up to.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra gave you the Mysterious Rose Seedling. According to Cassandra, if you hold onto it for 30 minutes, the rose will bloom. Deliver the Bloomed Rose to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra got her rose, and you got some nice-looking chocolate. Hope it tastes good, too.

0.0: I'm... really busy! I'd like to give out some chocolates and roses to spread joy and make people like me more, but I am SO busy that I don't have enough time to get the roses!
0.1: So, could you do me a favor? Could you please help me by getting roses? If you help me, I will give you some chocolate in return. And if you help me more often, I will give you even more!

yes.0: Perfect! Okay, take this seed and... um... wait? I think that's how it works. Maybe like 30 minutes, I guess. When the seed turns into a bloomed rose, bring it back!

no.0: Really? Well, when you want to help me, talk to me!

default.0: The rose has not bloomed yet. You have to take care of the Mysterious Rose Seedling for 30 minutes!
